name: OpenSecrets CRP API
tagline: US campaign finance and lobbying data from the Center for Responsive Politics
description: REST API for OpenSecrets (Center for Responsive Politics) providing US campaign finance, lobbying, and political contribution data. Includes endpoints for legislators, candidates, donors, PACs, industries, and organizations. Requires a free API key.

auth.details: API key via apikey query parameter; free self-serve signup at OpenSecrets API admin

use_cases: get current members of Congress for a US state
look up campaign finance summary for a candidate by CRP ID
find top industries contributing to a legislator
get organization profile and contribution totals
list top recipients of contributions from an industry
